description: This file appears to be a test script written in shell (bash/sh). It sets environment variables, sources a test library, and performs a series of tests related to the compatibility between CGit and JGit repositories, particularly focusing on 'reftable' features and ref management. The script defines multiple test functions and executes sequential tests to verify repository interoperability.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a file, stages it with jgit, and commits it with a message derived from the filename.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Fetches references from git and jgit, compares their outputs to verify consistency.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Checks if specific refs match between git and jgit.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Compares reflogs between git and jgit for consistency.
